newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sydkraft says HEW buy a negative for '97.
newsitem.headline: Sydkraft says HEW buy a negative for '97.

text.p: Swedish power company Sydkraft AB on Tuesday said its purchase of a stake in German utility HEW would be slightly negative for earnings in 1997.
"It means a slight negative weight in 1997," Sydkraft spokesman Lars Frithiof told Reuters.
Frithiof said the dividend will be a bit less than interest costs of three to four percent a year. Hamburgische Electricitats-Werke's (HEW) dividend was 8.50 marks in 1995.
Whether the purchase will burden Sydkraft's results in the coming year depends on how big the dividend is, he said.
Sydkraft has paid about 650 million marks for a 12.5 percent share of HEW, buying the stake from the German city of Hamburg.
